column1: # The defaults twins — one row a pin identity tools/check-defaults.py scans (lever,
# where, value collapse the sites). `twin` is `path::needle` — the clause that runs
# the same model path at the default, named by a literal substring of one of its
# lines that occurs exactly once in the file, so a clause that moved or vanished is
# red; a pin whose value already is the default's word may name its own clause.
# `none` needs a reason opening with a date, and every run of the check prints the
# count of those rows so the open gaps stay visible.
